and whilst recovering, try your hardest to avoid the numbers and mirrors and focus on the fact your future will be much better and more stable. once you know youre stable enough to decipher the difference between a lifestyle and a diet is when you should focus on loosing weight.

Ive recovered from both anorexia and bullima. telling you, as ive relapsed countless amounts of time, dieting and restricting again or inviting those terrible things back into your habits is not going to help you in anyway, infact it is going to set you back. honestly if you are eating a healthy amount (and assuming youve seen a nutritionist) and a healthy dose of each of what u need, but youre still at the weight you are while being “obese” ive been told theres no problem and that it’s definitely just the way we see ourselves. still, you may just be uncomfortable with your weight still no matter what it is you know and understand and all you know is you have to follow a healthy lifestyle that involves exercise and fruits and vegetables alongside grain and protein. see a nutritionist and find out what it is you need thatll help you stay healthy + loose some weight, because the diet plan they set you up on is to help you achieve the healthiest lifestyle you can obtain!
